mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (below 0.5%) signal accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% for two consecutive months indicates severe labor market distress, increasing corporate earnings volatility and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal collapsing consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession industrial recovery, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing expansion that boosts corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of recovery periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening residential construction, which precedes broader economic expansion and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST growth fails to predict positive 5-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 1-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession labor recovery, monthly payroll gains exceeding 50,000 jobs (PAYEMS) indicate sustained job creation that supports consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth above 50k fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signal robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint rise in INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
